item.name: Seeds of Serenity

effects.title: Verdurous Dale
effects.text: Target the ground with a 400 radius. Provides health regeneration to all allied units while they are in the area of effect equal to 8 + 25% of the caster's health regeneration at the time of casting. Lasts 8 seconds.

item.lore: An evergreen sprout treasured by the woodkin and highly coveted by interlopers and their like.
